Power Apps.feature_name: Filter grid columns by multiple selected values
Power Apps.description: This feature helps users quickly narrow grid results when records contain multiple selected values. Instead of manually scanning large lists or relying on broader filters, users can filter directly on multi-select choice columns to find the records that matter. This improves productivity, reduces time spent searching, and makes grid filtering more consistent with how users expect choice-based data to work.

Power Apps.feature_name: Refine global search with table scoping
Power Apps.description: You can make global search more focused and efficient with this feature. By scoping search results to specific tables, you can reduce irrelevant matches, quickly locate the records needed, and complete work with less friction. This is especially useful in apps with many searchable tables, where broad search results can be harder to review.

Power Automate.feature_name: Share Process license capacity across workflows
Power Automate.enabled_for: Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically
Power Automate.description: Save costs, reduce management effort, and improve resource utilization by efficiently sharing capacity across multiple flows.

Power Automate.feature_name: Visualize desktop flows with flow chart view
Power Automate.enabled_for: Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically
Power Automate.description: Designing automations becomes significantly easier when users can visualize the full structure of a desktop flow. The flow‑chart view helps makers better understand branching, sub-flows, decision points, and execution paths, enabling faster onboarding and reducing flow‑building errors. With a clearer representation of logic, teams can collaborate more effectively, troubleshoot issues faster, and confidently scale their automation estate.

Power Automate.feature_name: Automate PowerPoint presentations in desktop flows
Power Automate.enabled_for: Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically
Power Automate.description: This feature lets you automate routine PowerPoint tasks right in your desktop flows. You’ll cut down on manual work, keep your presentations consistent, and free up time to focus on what matters most. Plus, it makes it easy to integrate presentation creation into your broader business processes, helping you work smarter and faster.

Power Automate.feature_name: Export work queue items to CSV
Power Automate.enabled_for: Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically
Power Automate.description: This feature lets you quickly export work queue data from Automation Center into a CSV file, so you can dig deeper into analysis, create custom reports, and share insights across your teams. It helps you boost visibility, streamline collaboration, and make smarter decisions faster.

Power Automate.feature_name: Connect to local AI models from desktop flows
Power Automate.enabled_for: Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically
Power Automate.description: You can now add AI to your desktop flows without sending data outside your environment. By running models locally, you’ll keep control of your data, meet privacy standards, and cut down on dependency on external services. Plus, you’ll make the most of the AI investments you already have, helping your business work smarter and faster.

Power Automate.feature_name: Run Python scripts using current Python versions in desktop flows
Power Automate.enabled_for: Admins, makers, marketers, or analysts, automatically
Power Automate.description: You can now use the full Python ecosystem in your desktop flows without the old limitations of IronPython. With support for the latest Python versions, you’ll have access to popular libraries and tools, making it easier to create smarter, more flexible automations. This means faster development, fewer workarounds, and more powerful solutions for your business.

items.description: After meeting recap is automatically generated in the translation language chosen during the meeting, users can continue to change the language of the meeting recap after its generated.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Front-of-room view control for Town Hall in Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: When a Teams Rooms on Android is invited as a meeting presenter, the front-of-room display defaults to the attendee view. Presenters always have full control from the console, including green room and off-stage management, and can switch the front-of-room display to presenter view without impacting attendees. Available in Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
items.description: AI-powered visibility into DLP policy deployment across devices, helping admins track sync progress and understand enforcement coverage. They proactively identify impacted devices, explain root causes of sync failures, and guide admins with recommended actions to quickly diagnose and resolve issues.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
items.description: AI agent skill to detect and alert unhealthy policy sync and device configuration.

items.title: Outlook: Jump to Any Folder Instantly with Go to Folder
items.description: You can now quickly search for and navigate to any folder in your mailbox using the new Go to Folder feature. Instead of scrolling through long folder lists, just press Ctrl+Y or access it from your accounts context menu to instantly find what you need. Type a few letters of the folder name and jump straight there. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot improved long files navigation using document structure, enabling more accurate answers and clearer citations.
items.description: We’ve improved how Copilot reads long and complex files by making it more aware of document structure. When you ask a question, Copilot can now navigate to the most relevant parts of your document (for example, specific sections/pages) before answering—helping reduce missed details and improving confidence with clearer citations that are easier to trace back to the source. We have decided not to move forward with this feature. We apologize for the inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention – Reduce policy sync status SLA on the Purview UI from 2 hours to 30 mins
items.description: Admin should be able to see the Endpoint DLP policy sync status on the Purview portal within 30 mins.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Enhanced Topic Assignment
items.description: We're upgrading our topic assignment pipeline to be powered by Copilot, delivering significantly improved accuracy in categorizing survey comments into relevant topics.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ad-hoc room reservation from Teams Rooms on Android console
items.description: With Teams Rooms on Android consoles, you can quickly book a meeting room for immediate use, helping to avoid scheduling conflicts and ensure uninterrupted spontaneous meetings. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: Outlook: Support for AppleScript in the New Outlook for Mac
items.description: AppleScript workflows vary widely across organizations and often depend on behaviors from the classic app that don’t exist in the New Outlook. Because these patterns can’t be standardized, full compatibility isn’t feasible. We have decided not to move forward with this feature. We apologize for the inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Add Agents and Skills from the Plus menu
items.description: Users will be able to insert Agents and Skills in prompts for specialized tasks. They can add them from the Agents and Skills tab after selecting 'Add work content' from the plus (+) menu. Users can also access Agents and Skills by typing / and @ in their prompt.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365):  JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring images directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring structured lists and tables directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. This additional context helps Copilot generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.

items.title: SharePoint: HTML pages
items.description: Create HTML with Copilot in SharePoint or upload your own HTML from another source. Once stored in the pages library, you can render HTML as a page in SharePoint, make additional edits, and share with your audience. HTML gives you new ways to present your content beautifully alongside our existing ASPX pages.

items.title: OneNote: New Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app (DoD, GCC, GCC High)
items.description: The new Copilot Notebooks design in the Microsoft 365 Copilot app for DoD, GCC, and GCC High clouds now lets users organize related chats, output creations, and references into a persistent AI workspace. Copilot uses the Notebook's accumulated context to ground responses, so work continues across sessions instead of starting over each time. While this is the quicker, light-weight Notebooks experience, you can still find the workspace-forward experience in OneNote.

items.title: Microsoft Entra: Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform Single Sign-on can now be used as a second factor for MFA
items.description: Windows Hello for Business (WHfB) and macOS Platform SSO (macOS PSSO) can now satisfy multifactor authentication as a standalone second factor. Previously, these methods only counted as MFA during primary sign-in, and users needed a separate passkey to complete step-up prompts, Authentication Strength policies, and sign-in frequency checks. With this change, WHfB and macOS PSSO work on their own for those scenarios, so more of your users can rely on strong, phishing-resistant sign-in without reg

items.title: Microsoft Teams: See more messages on mobile
items.description: We are introducing a more streamlined messaging experience that displays more content on screen while improving readability when using Teams on mobile. These updates make it easier to scan conversations and follow the discussion flow, helping users stay productive and engaged wherever they work.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams shared display mode and peripheral detection available for DoD environments
items.description: Shared display mode in Teams is now available in government DOD environments, enabling more seamless and private meeting hosting from your PC. Additionally, peripheral detection for bring-your-own-device spaces is available for inventory management and reporting through the Pro Management portal.

items.title: OneDrive: PDF annotation for sensitivity-label protected PDFs in the OneDrive apps (iOS and Android)
items.description: The Microsoft OneDrive apps for iOS and Android will let users annotate PDFs protected by a Microsoft Purview Information Protection sensitivity label that applies encryption — without removing or weakening the label. Users with edit/annotate rights can add a full set of annotations — including ink, highlight, free text, notes, signatures, image/shape/date stamps, bookmarks, and form fields — directly in the OneDrive mobile PDF viewer; the file's encryption and usage rights are preserved end to

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Protect sensitive data over FTP and SFTP with Endpoint DLP
items.description: Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP enables organizations to monitor and protect sensitive data transferred from managed endpoints using FTP and SFTP, helping prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility and control.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Queues app for Microsoft Teams in GCC High and DoD
items.description: We’re excited to announce that the Queues app is now available in the GCC High and DoD clouds. This Teams-native app helps organizations manage customer engagements more efficiently by bringing advanced call queue and auto attendant capabilities directly into Teams. Queues app is a Teams Premium feature. For more information about Queues app, including licensing information, please see Manage Queues app for Microsoft Teams in your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery - In-product diagnostics to troubleshoot common challenges
items.description: Self-service diagnostics help identify common issues with case permissions, security filters, and policy status. The experience highlights potential misconfigurations and provides simple guidance to help customers understand and resolve them. This brings basic troubleshooting into the product and helps eDiscovery admins overcome common challenges.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - User Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
items.description: Enable aggregation of DLP alerts based on common entities user even when multiple rules are matched. This feature should consolidate related alert events into a single alert object to: Reduce alert noise, simplify investigation workflows, enhance contextual understanding of violations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Get actionable suggestions from Copilot in your Copilot Page
items.description: Request feedback from Copilot on your Page by selecting "Suggested edits" in the Copilot Shortcuts menu. Copilot will analyze the content on your page and provide actionable suggestions about what you can change to improve clarity and quality of your written content. You can then apply suggestions directly to the page.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Count of Labelled Documents Condition
items.description: This release introduces a new condition for Exchange Online policies: “Count of labeled documents is greater than.”  This condition evaluates the number of attachments in an email message that carry a matching sensitivity label. When the count exceeds a defined threshold, the DLP rule is triggered, and configured actions are applied. This capability enables detection of high-volume data exfiltration scenarios, where multiple sensitive files—individually low-risk—collectively represent a signific

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Reusable Global List for Exchange Online
items.description: Reusable Lists centralize management of keywords, domains, and email addresses, eliminating duplication across rules and reducing the effort required to maintain large policies.

items.title: Teams Meetings in Copilot Notebooks
items.description:
Meetings as References in Copilot Notebooks bring Teams meeting content into the notebook experience, enabling users to ground Copilot on the discussions, decisions, and context that drive their work. By adding meetings as knowledge sources, users can connect transcripts, notes, chats, and shared content directly to their projects, enriching notebooks beyond files alone and improving downstream outputs like presentations and briefs. 

Available in Copilot Notebooks across Microsoft 365.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Efficiency Mode
items.description: Teams efficiency mode improves performance and responsiveness on hardware constrained devices by applying a reduced resource configuration by default, helping maintain meeting quality and responsiveness during collaboration.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Test your microphone before you join
items.description: Before joining a meeting on your pre-join screen, you can test your microphone and speaker to make sure others will hear you clearly. Select Test mic and speaker to record a short audio clip and play it back. This helps you confirm that the right devices are selected and that you’ll be heard—and hear others—once the meeting starts.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management– Hard delete capability for OneDrive and SharePoint through secure priority cleanup workflows
items.description: Data Lifecycle Management allows compliance admins to retain, review and delete content in M365 workloads. Deletion of content to adhere to compliance requirements, admins can set up Retention policies or labels. To help prevent inadvertent data loss, M365 retention labels policies and M365 retention policies do not hard delete content immediately and keeps the data in Recycle Bins for 93 days for ODSP. Hard delete itself is a very costly process as it opens Microsoft to heavy legal implications

items.title: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
items.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing.  New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Room health signals and notifications in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: When critical issues impact room functionality, users see a banner notification on both the front-of-room display and console in Teams Rooms on Windows.  Room health signals help get issues resolved quickly and ensure productive meetings. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Agents usage report
items.description: A new agents usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center. The report will be scoped to include agents in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat with usage by both M365 Copilot licensed and unlicensed users. The report will include total active agent users, total active agents, active users segmentation by licensed and unlicensed users, and active users and active agents segmentation by publisher type (i.e. user-created agents, agents built by your org, agents built by Microsoft, agen

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ability to separate out the Townhall attendee invites
items.description: This backend change will now address the 'separation of attendee' invites from the events crew. This feature allows the organizers of Townhalls to maintain separate invites for attendees.

items.title: Microsoft Purview compliance portal:  eDiscovery (Premium) – Hold reports
items.description: Out-of-the-box reports that contain information about all legal holds associated with eDiscovery cases in the Microsoft Purview compliance portal. Sort and filter your view based on various criteria and download the aggregated information for further analysis. Note: The status and release month has been updated to reflect the current state. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
